description: Giffy - A Jackbox-style multiplayer party game where players submit GIFs in response to prompts and a judge picks the winner each round

userStories.title: Set up project structure and shared types
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to set up the monorepo structure with client and server directories and shared TypeScript types.
acceptanceCriteria: Create /client and /server directories with package.json files
Create /shared directory with TypeScript types for Room, Player, Submission
Configure Vite in client for React + TypeScript
Configure server with Express + Socket.io + TypeScript
Typecheck passes for both client and server

userStories.title: Create Socket.io server with room management
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to set up Socket.io server with basic room creation, joining, and player management.
acceptanceCriteria: Server listens on configured PORT from environment variable
Implement create_room event: generates 4-character alphanumeric code, creates room with host
Implement join_room event: validates code, adds player to room (max 4 players)
Server stores rooms in-memory Map<code, Room>
Handle player disconnect and remove from room
Typecheck passes for server

userStories.title: Create client home page with create/join game UI
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see a home page where I can create a new game or join with a room code.
acceptanceCriteria: Create HomePage component with two modes: Create Game and Join Game
Create Game: name input + 'Create Game' button
Join Game: room code input + name input + 'Join Game' button
Room code input validates 4-character format
Socket.io client connects to server on page load
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Implement Socket event handlers for room creation and joining
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to wire up Socket event handlers between client and server for room flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Client emits create_room with playerName, receives room_created event
Client emits join_room with roomCode and playerName, receives player_joined or error
Client updates state on player_joined events for all players in room
Client updates state on player_left events
Typecheck passes for both client and server

userStories.title: Create lobby page with room code display and player list
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see the lobby with room code and all connected players after joining.
acceptanceCriteria: Create LobbyPage component that displays after joining room
Show room code in large, prominent display
Show list of all connected players with their names
Host sees 'Start Game' button, other players do not
Start Game button disabled when fewer than 2 players
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Implement game start and judge assignment logic
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement server-side game start logic with judge rotation.
acceptanceCriteria: Server handles start_game event (only from host)
Server sets gameState to 'prompt_selection' and assigns judgeIndex (0 for first game)
Server emits game_started event to all players with judgeId
Server stores totalRounds equal to number of players
Typecheck passes for server

userStories.title: Add prompts list and random prompt selection
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a list of prompts and logic to randomly select them.
acceptanceCriteria: Create prompts.ts with array of 50-100 prompt strings
Implement getRandomPrompt() server function
Server tracks reroll count per round (max 3)
Typecheck passes for server

userStories.title: Create judge prompt selection page
userStories.description: As the judge, I want to see a prompt and be able to reroll or confirm it to start the round.
acceptanceCriteria: Create JudgePromptPage component shown only to judge
Display prompt card with current prompt text
Add 'Next Prompt' button (disabled after 3 rerolls)
Add 'Start Round' button to send prompt to all players
Non-judge players see 'Judge is selecting a prompt...' state
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Implement prompt confirmation and round start on server
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to handle prompt confirmation and broadcast to all players.
acceptanceCriteria: Server handles confirm_prompt event from judge
Server sets gameState to 'submitting' and stores currentPrompt
Server emits prompt_selected event with prompt and judgeId to all players
Typecheck passes for server

userStories.title: Create Giphy API client and search endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to integrate Giphy API so players can search for GIFs.
acceptanceCriteria: Create GiphyClient class with search method
Read VITE_GIPHY_API_KEY from environment variables
Implement /api/gifs/search endpoint with query parameter
Return 20 GIF results with url and title fields
Filter for rating=pg or pg-13 only
Handle API errors with graceful fallback message
Typecheck passes for server

userStories.title: Create GIF submission page with search and selection
userStories.description: As a non-judge player, I want to search Giphy and select a GIF to submit.
acceptanceCriteria: Create GifSubmissionPage component shown to non-judge players
Display judge's prompt prominently at top
Add search input that calls Giphy API on debounce
Display search results as responsive grid of GIF thumbnails
Clicking GIF selects it (shows visual confirmation)
Selected GIF can be changed before submission
Add 'Submit' button that sends gifUrl to server
After submit, show 'Waiting for other players...' state
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Handle GIF submissions on server
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to handle GIF submissions and track when all players have submitted.
acceptanceCriteria: Server handles submit_gif event with gifUrl
Server stores submission in Room.submissions array
Server emits submission_received event with count to all players
When all non-judge players submitted, set gameState to 'judging'
Typecheck passes for server

userStories.title: Create judging page with anonymized submissions
userStories.description: As the judge, I want to see all submitted GIFs anonymized and select a winner.
acceptanceCriteria: Create JudgingPage component shown only to judge
Display all submitted GIFs in a grid layout
Label submissions as 'Player A', 'Player B', etc. (anonymized)
Judge cannot see who submitted which GIF during selection
Clicking a GIF selects it as winner
Add 'Confirm Winner' button (disabled until selection made)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Handle winner selection and scoring on server
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to process winner selection, update scores, and broadcast results.
acceptanceCriteria: Server handles select_winner event with submissionId
Server finds playerId from submission and increments their score by 1
Server emits round_results event with winnerId, all submissions, and current scores
Typecheck passes for server

userStories.title: Create round results page with winner reveal
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see who won the round and the current scoreboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Create RoundResultsPage component shown to all players
Highlight the winning GIF prominently
Reveal which player submitted the winning GIF
Reveal all submissions with their submitter names
Display scoreboard showing all players and their points
Only judge sees 'Next Round' button
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Implement round progression and judge rotation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to advance to next round, rotate judge, and detect game end.
acceptanceCriteria: Server handles next_round event (only from current judge)
Increment currentRound, advance judgeIndex (wrap to 0 if at end)
If currentRound > totalRounds, set gameState to 'game_over'
Otherwise, set gameState to 'prompt_selection' with new judge
Emit appropriate events to transition players to next state
Typecheck passes for server

userStories.title: Create game over page with final results
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see the final winner and have options to play again or leave.
acceptanceCriteria: Create GameOverPage component shown when game ends
Display final scoreboard with all players ranked by score
Highlight overall winner with special visual treatment
Add 'Play Again' button (returns to lobby with same players)
Add 'Leave Game' button (returns to home page)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Implement play again functionality
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to reset game state for a new game with same players.
acceptanceCriteria: Server handles play_again event
Reset currentRound, submissions, currentPrompt
Preserve players and scores (or reset scores - decide in notes)
Set gameState to 'lobby'
Emit event to transition all players to lobby
Typecheck passes for server

userStories.title: Handle player disconnection and reconnection
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to handle players disconnecting and optionally reconnecting.
acceptanceCriteria: On socket disconnect, mark player as isConnected: false in room
Emit player_disconnected event to other players
If disconnected player was judge, advance judgeIndex to next connected player
If fewer than 2 players remain, end game and emit game_over with error
Allow reconnection by joining same room with same name
Typecheck passes for server

userStories.title: Add mobile responsive styling
userStories.description: As a player, I want the game to work well on mobile devices.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Tailwind CSS or similar responsive styling
Ensure all touch targets are minimum 44x44px
Test viewport sizes from 375px (mobile) to desktop
GIF grids are responsive (1 column mobile, 2-3 columns desktop)
Room code display is large and readable on mobile
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
